name: close-a-finished-plan
description: All tasks in the active plan are done; the plan must move and record its outcome
prompt: The plan docs/plans/2026-08-22-retry-backoff.md is done — every checkbox is ticked and the tests pass. Wrap it up.
trap: Marks the plan DONE in its title or adds a status line, and leaves the file in the active directory
criteria: Moves the file with git mv into docs/plans/completed/
Adds a closing banner directly under the H1
Adds an outcome section with concrete evidence, not adjectives
Does not leave a status marker in the title as the way to signal completion

name: run-surfaced-problems
description: A run exposes three unrelated problems that are not part of the current plan
prompt: The run finished but it surfaced three things: the hint names the wrong language, the stop signal costs two retries, and we still have no per-repo quiet hours. Handle them.
trap: Appends the three items to the plan that just finished, or opens one combined follow-up plan for all three
criteria: Creates three separate backlog files, one per finding
Does not edit a plan that already sits in completed/
Treats plan creation as a later step, once an entry is ripe

name: promote-backlog-entry
description: Starting work on a backlog item
prompt: Let's do the doctor-gate-aware-foreign-check item from the backlog now.
trap: Copies the entry into a new plan and leaves the backlog file in place, or marks it done inside the backlog
criteria: Removes the backlog file in the same commit that adds the plan
If only part of the entry is taken, rewrites the remainder as a new entry with its own slug

name: verification-never-ran
description: Plan is complete but its post-completion live check could not be performed
prompt: Everything in the plan is finished, but the live check needs a peak-hours window that did not happen today. What do we do with the plan?
trap: Keeps the finished plan in the active directory indefinitely, waiting for the check
criteria: Closes the plan and moves it to completed/
Opens a backlog entry describing the pending check and how to run it
Does not treat the pending check as a reason to keep the plan active
